Railway Empire 2 is a railroad construction and management simulation game developed by Gaming Minds Studio and published by Kalypso Media. It will be released on 25 May 2023 for Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft Windows, Xbox Series X and S, Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. The Nintendo Switch version has been also announced but will be released on a later date
Scenario
Similar to the first title, you are tasked with taking over a small railway company in the 19th century.
Key new Elements
On 20 April 2023, Kalypso Media shared a FAQ on its Steam community page with some new and exclusive elements that players can expect on Railway Empire 2. Some of them are a Co-op mode for up to 4 players, 60 detailed and historically accurate engines, Paint your locomotives, 14 different scenarios, among many others.
